head_of_line.interpretation: Artificial 25ms hold demonstrates coupling only. It does not prove a real sub-1ms violation or require architecture change. Raw scenario samples retained.

classification.decision: Keep single sender; injected duration does not establish real performance or require multi-sender

contract.startup: Exclusive sender/chain owner with durable session epoch and canonical checkpoint; arm only after independent reconciliation, never from a manually reused first_nonce.
contract.durability_before_hotpath: Before arming, durably fence a bounded nonce range/session. A crash quarantines the whole outstanding range if per-intent durability is incomplete. No synchronous filesystem/DB wait is introduced in the hotpath by this design.
contract.restart_default: DISARMED/QUARANTINED. Reserved and Prepared are not assumed unsent when last in-memory transition was lost. Sending is never automatically resent. Confirmed requires canonical revalidation and persistent intent dedup.
contract.canonical_reconciliation: Verify chain, sender nonce, tx hash, receipt and canonical block; acquire/cost evidence separately. Handle reorg by quarantine. ACK, pending nonce, missing receipt or expired builder window alone do not prove an unmined signed transaction cannot later execute.
contract.release: No automatic reuse or cancellation of ambiguous nonce. Require canonical nonce consumption or explicit reviewed recovery proof. Missing/incomplete history keeps entire relevant lane quarantined.
contract.multi_lane_constraint: Independent sender lanes require shared economic-intent admission across senders; per-sender dedup alone permits duplicate portfolio BUYs. No multi-lane deployment is authorized or implemented by this record.

recipient_binding.binding: ticket chain/sender/token -> recovered signer + nonce + Portal destination + decoded swap outputToken
recipient_binding.semantics: Direct Portal ABI has no recipient field. Recipient equals direct caller only under pinned G0.3 semantics; this does not requalify future runtime/state.
